_comment: Redacted EXAMPLE of the runner-monitor registry — placeholder values only.
The live registry is instance state on the hub volume on monitor-hub and is
NEVER committed (mon-registry-01). See runners.schema.json for the shape.
Two shapes of the same field, because the null one is the one that gets
misread: a host that cannot serve the pinned image still heartbeats, and
its null is UNKNOWN — not healthy, and not ready to gate (img-cycle-03).
